sn35.165:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3
sn35.165:1.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.165:1.3: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatīti || || 4-9
sn35.165:2.1: Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati ||
sn35.165:2.2: rūpe aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati ||
sn35.165:2.3: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati ||
sn35.165:2.4: cakkhusamphassam aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati || pa ||
sn35.165:2.5: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati || || 10
sn35.165:2.6: Evam kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatīti || || 2-3
